name: Dollhouse Kit
description: A modular 1:6 playscale dollhouse for 29-30 cm fashion dolls, printed as panels on one 150 mm grid that key together into as big a house as you like: walls, window walls, two-course door walls with hinged Dutch-door leaves, L corner posts, floor tiles, roof panels, two-part stairs, railings, and the hourglass keys, pegs and hinge pins that join them. A room is two 210 mm wall courses (420 mm ceiling); every piece fits a 300 x 300 x 300 mm envelope and prints without supports. Styles for siding, brick, stone and stucco outside, striped, dotted, diamond, heart and star wallpaper, wainscoting, window shutters and flower boxes, wood-plank, herringbone, tiled and checkerboard floors, rugs and shingled roofs, with up to 31 colour parameters in extruder order.
source: inspired by MakerWorld "Fully Modular & Scaleable Dollhouse" by 6POiNT6 (#1417985, 841 downloads, 1.2k likes; 1:18, scale 300% for 1:6), MakerWorld "A Modular Dollhouse Garden Cottage" (#472786, 1.0k downloads) and "Modular 3d Printed Doll House" (#919649, 305 downloads); key-in-pocket joints after OpenLOCK (Printables "#NoWalls Standard Dungeon Tiles (OpenLock/MagBall)" #11945, 2.4k downloads)
